AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Making Tacking Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
